name: I Drink Your Milkshake!
subtitle: original Open R&D concept by Lioge
rules: You may search your opponent's deck for a card. If you do, remove it from the game face-down. For the rest of the game, if your opponent plays a card, you may reveal the removed card if it has the same name. If you do, you may play it for free even if you cannot meet its threshold and terminate your opponent's card. (Playing a resource does not trigger this effect.)
flavor: Don't trust anyone. Not even yourself.
notes: Printed: 'you may play it for free even if you cannot meet its threshold and terminate your opponent's card' (the 'may' covers both the play and the terminate). Catalog: 'you may deploy it for free even if you cannot meet its threshold. If you deploy it, terminate the opponent's card.' (terminate is mandatory on deploy). May/must difference on the terminate clause. Also printed 'remove from the game face-down' vs catalog 'put it in the void face-down', 'your opponent plays a card' vs 'that opponent deploys a card' (terminology only).
